reviews.x: Bought this for my boyfriend who loves to powerlift. He is so impressed & loves them! I would recommend this product over others that I found on Amazon

reviews.t: New personal best thanks to this product
reviews.x: Surprisingly, the smelling sticks helped me reach a new pr on my deadlift!

reviews.t: Does what its meant to 💯 highly recommend
reviews.x: ❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤This is a LIFE changer 💯So i orderd this honestly because the person in my family was sick i knew it was a chance hed pass away ....and i knew i needed to help the whole family while they grieved and were passing out alcohol worked but this Made them Gain control and wake up And be able to walk ...through all this......its very strong i popped it and waved it quick around there face ...it realy helped our family ......i use to work in a lab and we always carried these for if someone pass

Great smelling salts. Im on the road a lot for my job and driving tired is dangerous. Coffee sometimes doesn't cut it or work fast enough. I always keep a bottle of these in my go bag and crack em when the eyes start getting heavy so I can find a place to nap. Also work great if you're at your desk for hours and need a quick mental jolt!
Bought them for a friend and he highly enjoys them and I do as well. I also enjoy the novelty of cracking it open. I think it adds a certain subconscious intensity to it as well.
These definitely do not smell like daisies. In fact, they smell more like alcohol and chlorine

Hey, you, don’t just waste your money. I’ll break it to ya—It’s a placebo. Don’t listen to those other reviews, as I will tell you straight-as-an-arrow here, it did nothing but make a very strong 6 second smell for you to inhale that could make you tear up. “Did it do anything afterwards?” No. Just look elsewhere and buy a Effin Bang energy if you want to feel pumped up. This is nothing but a ruse in a bottle.
I haven't been to the gym in 2wks. Took a few sniffs and it was like I never missed a beat. Even added 15lb+ to my sets. Don't know of it's mental or really works but I'm not complaining

We got this for our 13 year old as a joke because she is always smelling stuff. Everything she touches she smells first. It's strange. Anyways.... it's worth your money. Longevity: I would say pretty good. Accidently put it in the washer. It didn't leak out of the bottle at all. Checked to see if it still smells . Yep it does. Ammonia is a pretty difficult sent to get rid of. Easy to use: Well yes. If you can breath you can probably use it.

reviews.t: Weightlifting extensions for a few more extra pumps.
reviews.x: It’s interesting, it’ll wake you up like an electric bolt. It’s smells very strong like ammonia. You can say it does the job . It’s not good for the weak but just right for the thrill seeker who wants to do a few more extra pumps on weights at the gym ...

reviews.t: Be sure to record the reaction of the recipient.
reviews.x: Recently went camping with friends and we had a bet on what time a certain friend would pass out in his chair. We'd decide on a time and have to either take the under or over. I had these on hand so I took the over. Needless to say I won.
I would highly recommend this product it will get you pumped up and ready to go for your work out or skip your morning coffee and just sniff one of these
These are strong an exactly why I need for my big lifts

Works well but isn’t as strong as the first time. It kinda feels like eating a lot of wasabi at once, does wake you up. Would say it’s improved my focus and energy before a workout 4/5.  Update: i have had it for two weeks, i keep it in my gym bag and it seems to have lost its smell and potency. pretty bummed out it only lasted about 2 weeks.
Sucks to inhale but it definitely gives you a boost. The boost is very short lived but it is good for a couple of strong pushes

Just as a heads up to the consumer, this is a bottle with liquid in it not the pouches you snap open. Be careful and do not spill this, you can figure out why. However these are the strongest salts I have ever tried and would suggest.

reviews.t: Do not wast your money. Very weak stuff
reviews.x: I use smelling salts for weight lifting. This stuff is by far the worst. I can literally put my nose in the bottle and barely smell amonia. Waste of money. I don’t know what all these other comments are talking about because this stuff is garbage.

For some reason I thought this was gonna be the packets you break and sniff.( my bad)  But other than that it works very well. Gets similar results to packets. BE PREPARED FOR THAT FIRST WIFFF.   However I feel like it dries out quick.

Well I fell for it. This doesn't make you more alert or make you able to work out longer. What a joke. All it does is burn your nose and make you never forget that smell. At least it wasn't an expensive mistake buying this.

The item says it's twist and sniff smelling salts but it is not.  It arrives in a little bottle full of gunky gel that smells like smelling salts.  If you remove the lid the stench shoots out and it's pretty unbearable
[[VIDEOID:a27cfd479b81139230c6c69548582e63]] It doesn't smell horrible, defenetly helped get more air in the lungs and allowed me to keep my brace longer
Misleading. They don’t send you smelling salts. I just got a small jar of gunk that smelled like smelling salts. Not the same.

reviews.t: Not what I thought it was
reviews.x: I ordered these thinking they were the smelling salt sticks but it is just liquid in a bottle

reviews.t: Not worth it. Get the rock form
reviews.x: There’s no boost feeling like the packets you have to crack to activate. Don’t see how this could help someone in weightlifting at all.. just burns your nose for a couple seconds like usual and then that’s it..no other stimulation or sudden burst of energy like others. Get the rock form or stick to the packets you have to pop

reviews.t: They mislead you thinking they are The capsules
reviews.x: They make you think it’s the snap capsules when it really comes in the gel form so they miss lead you there. The package arrives to the house is done leaked all inside its bag so yeah not very happy. Wouldn’t purchase!!

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product works as intended, giving a strong wake-up boost or helping with workouts and lifts.
Several reviewers note the smell is very strong, like ammonia, alcohol, or chlorine, and some find it unpleasant to inhale.
A few reviewers mention the effect is short-lived or that potency fades after opening.
Some reviewers question whether it works mentally or as a placebo, though they still report benefits.
A few reviewers highlight the novelty and fun of cracking it open or using it as a joke/gift.
